purpose: A repeatable production pattern for a beginner-facing Gemara tractate block. Each block teaches transferable reading, not only the tractate's facts.

requiredStages.outcome: Name the Mishnah's case, people, objects, and setting before seeking a ruling.
Recognize the Hebrew/Aramaic signals that predict the next textual move.
Map question, source, objection, distinction, response, and interim conclusion.
Apply the move to a second, genuinely different source in the same tractate.
Build and explain an interactive source map on a short passage.
Retrieve a fragile move after time has passed.
Read an unfamiliar source and state one uncertainty responsibly.

releaseRule: No tractate block is production-complete until every learner-facing packet passes the source-review schema and has a second source context.
